summary: A full Saturday of European league football, college football, UFC and the ESL Pro League semifinals; most kept legs sit at or slightly below de-vigged bookmaker prices and were trimmed accordingly. Exclusions are mainly unconfirmed key availability (QBs at Tennessee, Cal, UCF, Nevada; Rashford/Mainoo, Watanabe, Rucker, Blount) plus Challenger tennis and non-tier-1 esports.

verdicts.reason: Starting QB unconfirmed: ESPN and On3 report freshman George MacIntyre will make his first start with Faizon Brandon hurt (shoulder), but Heupel has not confirmed; DraftKings -550/+410 de-vigs to 0.812 (opened 0.832); numberFire 75.7%.
